compilation_and_warmup.first_run_interpretation: first_timestep_s is reported separately, but this reference timestep path does not call Numba dispatchers; it is not JIT cost

statewise_comparison.reason: The surviving array benchmark is a synthetic five-zone/four-person readable-input scenario, while the trusted object baseline uses the current AbbeySimulation one-person/eight-zone config. No authoritative shared object-to-array scenario adapter exists in the frozen source, so claiming per-field equivalence would be misleading. Structural, physical, logging, repeatability, and energy/path invariants are checked instead.

scenario.other_optional_kernels: thermal, airflow, CO2, moisture, daylight enabled
